## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Paris, France. It starts at Musée du quai Branly - Jacques Chirac, 37 Quai Branly, 75007, Paris. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket to Musée du Quai Branly - Jacques Chirac.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Beneath the iconic Eiffel Tower, the Quai Branly Museum - Jacques Chirac houses an extensive collection of masks, musical instruments, weaponry, ceremonial items, paintings, and tapestries, among other things.
>
> It presents an exhibition of 3,500 artifacts within a single setting, representing regions such as Oceania, Asia, Africa, and the Americas.
>
> Within its walls, explore artwork and artifacts from diverse cultures spanning from Vancouver to Vanuatu, and Uluru to Uganda. The collection effectively showcases the vast spectrum of cultural diversity across the world.
>
> The exterior of the building boasts Jacques Chirac's vertical garden, large multihued blocks, and a series of structures reminiscent of a radiator's interior. With its unique architecture and remarkable anthropological relics, the Quai Branly Museum - Jacques Chirac is a sanctuary for those with an inquisitive spirit, both inside and out.
